## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. "I always have to manually adjust bitrate on congested Wi-Fi networks").

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Android / Windows specifics
Any specific Android versions, hardware features, or Windows desktop APIs relevant to this request.

## Additional context
Add any mockups, screenshots, or additional context about the feature request here.
